name: Usami Shinji
source:
The school doctor at Yamanoue High School. His family runs the general hospital. He's the second son, being younger than both his older brother and older sister. His brother will inherit the hospital.

He seems to be friends with Soga-sensei because of his sadistic nature, but he doesn't really like noisy children.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080611175737/http://www.hanerom.dojin.com/natuiro_cyara_sinji.html]official website[/url]]
